abilities._comment: Was a TRIGGERED ability on ON_PLAY_ACTIVATE_ATTACK, which nothing dispatched -- and the wrong shape besides: 'if this was played from arsenal it gains go again' is a static on the card itself, not a reaction to playing some other attack. The card also PRINTS GoAgain, so it had go again unconditionally while the gate was dead.

_comment: Printed text is identical to promise_of_plenty_red, which was converted and verified, so the implementation is copied wholesale rather than re-derived. The card PRINTS GoAgain and the engine applies a printed keyword unconditionally, so the gate was decoration and the card always had go again. loader.conditional_keywords() strips the printed keyword only for a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated grant, which is why the shape matters. WHILE_STATIC rather than TRIGGERED because CR 6.2.3d evaluates a conditional static-continuous effect at all times.
